title: An Idea Becomes a Connected System

scenes.title: The idea lights the system
scenes.purpose: A silhouette figure on a twilight hill raises a bulb. Its warm light opens a lighter fog band, and strings of light link five ridge buildings into one connected system.
visuals: Stationary indigo twilight sky with seeded static stars
Dim fog band plus lit fog value step revealed through an SVG mask disc grown from the bulb
Far ridge Paper.js compound contour with five structures and window cutouts
Near hill and figure in one near-black foreground value; raised-arm pose group pivots at the shoulder
Warm amber kept for light only: bulb, bloom, light strings and lit windows
Tracked serif title with thin rule, plus italic subtitle in the upper-left negative space

beats.development: The title fades in. The figure dips the dark bulb in anticipation, then swings the arm up around the shoulder pivot.
The bulb switches on in stepped exposure and the bloom expands. A masked light disc lifts the fog band to its lit value as the ridge of structures rises from behind the near hill.

A string of light draws from the bulb to the first building. Each window lights only when its string arrives, then the chain continues across the ridge and a cross-link closes the network. The subtitle appears.
Settled hold on the complete lit system and both lines of copy.

findings: Primary focus moves in one direction: from the figure to the bulb, then out along the strings to the ridge, following the reading order.
All motion ends by 2.31 s, leaving a fully legible hold of about 0.7 s.
justifiedHolds: 2.3-3.0 s: the closing hold gives time to read the subtitle and take in the finished network.
